_readme: Dev-only advisories with no available fix, read by scripts/check-audit.mjs. Production dependencies can never be excepted. Every entry expires within 45 days, and an entry for an advisory no longer reported fails the gate until it is removed.

exceptions.reason: Reached only via eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch, at lint time, with glob patterns from our own config. No patched braces exists: 3.0.3 is both the latest release and the vulnerable range bound. Not in the production dependency tree (npm audit --omit=dev is clean).
